parsed.internal_thinking: Claude is playing the 'peaceful neighbor' card again, just like last game before he turned on me. He's taking the 7-11-12 and 6-7-11 areas, which gives him a solid base. I don't buy the 'open view' talk for a second.
parsed.note_to_self: Claude is expanding towards the coast/ports (edge 25-36 leads to the Ore port). He has a very balanced setup with Wheat, Sheep, Brick, and Ore. I need to secure my second settlement on high-yield Ore and Wheat to keep up.
